newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Tech bags big order from Opel.
newsitem.headline: VA Tech bags big order from Opel.

text.p: VA Transport- und Montagesysteme, a subsidiary of Austrian engineering group VA Tech's VA MCE, said on Tuesday it had received an order worth some 580 million schillings from carmaker Adam Opel AG of Germany.
The order comprises the delivery of five body-in-white welding lines for the underbody of the Opel Astra successor.
Two manufacturing lines each would be installed at the works in Bochum, Germany and Belgium's Antwerp, and one in Ellesmere, England, the company said in a statement.
Production is planned to start at the beginning of 1997.
VA MCE is a systems supplier for hydraulic power generation, steel construction, services, and mechanical systems.
